_comment: Mock search results for offline testing. Keys are query strings (or substrings — MockSearcher does case-insensitive substring match). Each value is a list of {title, snippet, url} objects. Use this to dry-run the harness on the VM (or anywhere) without hitting a live search API.

Hamilton Depression Scale 1960 sample si.title: A rating scale for depression — Hamilton, 1960
Hamilton Depression Scale 1960 sample si.snippet: The original 1960 paper reports the scale as developed and tested on a sample of 49 inpatients with primary depressive illness at a single psychiatric hospital.

Hamilton Depression Scale 1960 sample si.title: History of depression rating scales — review
Hamilton Depression Scale 1960 sample si.snippet: Hamilton's 1960 validation used 49 patients across two centres; later expanded validations used larger samples.

world record heaviest pumpkin.title: Giant Pumpkin World Records
world record heaviest pumpkin.snippet: Competitive pumpkin growing focuses on weight, not lifting. The current heaviest grown pumpkin (2023) is 1,247 kg.

world record heaviest pumpkin.title: Strongman lifts — pumpkin events
world record heaviest pumpkin.snippet: There is no widely recognised 'pumpkin lifting' record; pumpkin growing competitions and strongman events do not overlap.

Hofstede Pakistan IBM sample size.title: Hofstede's original IBM survey country breakdown
Hofstede Pakistan IBM sample size.snippet: Country sample sizes in the original IBM survey are reported in the 1980 monograph; Pakistan was included in the 40-country expansion with limited coverage.

SSRI adolescent depression effect size.title: Meta-analysis: SSRI in adolescent depression
SSRI adolescent depression effect size.snippet: Pooled SMD across 14 RCTs in adolescents was 0.30 (95% CI 0.20-0.40), with fluoxetine showing the largest individual effect (SMD ~0.50).

CBT adolescent depression effect size.title: Meta-analysis: CBT in adolescent depression
CBT adolescent depression effect size.snippet: Pooled effect size for CBT vs control is approximately SMD 0.34 (95% CI 0.23-0.45) in adolescent depression trials.
